title: Make SDDC LCM support bundle generation safe to retry
prompt:
The VcfSddcLcm PowerShell module collects component support bundles from the VCF 9.1 SDDC LCM service. The service's generateComponentSupportBundle operation is not idempotent: every POST mints a new task and a new multi-gigabyte bundle, so retried runbooks and re-run CI jobs keep filling the appliance datastore.

Implement src/VcfSddcLcm/VcfSddcLcm.psm1 so the same logical request submitted twice produces exactly one bundle. Use a caller-supplied correlation ID as the idempotency key: check every getTasks result page for an existing task carrying that ID before submitting, and adopt it instead of POSTing again. The SDK connection returned by Connect-VcfSddcManagerServer exposes the appliance URI and bearer token as ServiceUri and SessionSecret.

The wire shape matters as much as the behaviour. docs/contract.json is the authoritative contract, derived from specifications/sddc-lcm/sddc-lcm-openapi.yaml in vmware/vcf-api-specs at the commit recorded in docs/official_sources.json. Optional fields that the caller did not set must be omitted from the request rather than sent empty - a body of {"lookBackWindow":0} or {"lookBackWindow":null} is not equivalent to {}, and unused query filters must not appear at all. pageNumber is used only after the initial getTasks page when another page is required.

Read README.md for the full requirements. Work only in src/; docs/, mock/, tests/ and tools/ are protected. VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager is installed by the environment and declared in the module manifest - never vendor it into the repository.

Verify with: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File tests/verify.ps1

requires.name: pwsh
requires.reason: Module target runtime and verifier host.

prerequisites.name: VMware.Sdk.Vcf.SddcManager
prerequisites.reason: Declared in the module manifest's RequiredModules. Installed by the environment; the seed never vendors it. Pulls VMware.OpenAPI, VMware.Vim and VMware.VimAutomation.* (~270 MB).

network.setup: required (PowerShell Gallery, to install the SDK prerequisite)
network.verification: not required; the verifier uses an in-process transport double and opens no sockets

verification.description: Uses a deterministic in-process transport double pinned to docs/contract.json, drives the module against it, and asserts the exact shape of every request: one POST per correlation ID across a submit-and-retry sequence even when the matching task is on a later page, an empty JSON object when the optional field is unset, only the intended task filters and required pageNumber, the X-Correlation-Id and bearer Authorization headers, and no call to any operation outside the contract.
asserts: retrying with the same correlation ID issues no second POST
an existing correlation ID on a later getTasks page is adopted
an SDK connection is read through ServiceUri and SessionSecret
an unset optional body property is omitted, not sent as null, empty or 0
a supplied optional property serialises as a JSON number
unused optional query parameters never reach the wire
the module calls only the four operationIds named in the contract
the SDK prerequisite is required by the manifest and not vendored into the repo

sources.note: The contract is derived from the OpenAPI specification file itself, not from a rendered documentation page. See files/docs/official_sources.json for the full record.
